entities.summary: Alexander Vladimirovich Bumagin is a Russian professional ice hockey player who currently plays with Danish club, Frederikshavn White Hawks in the Metal Ligaen (DEN). He was selected by the Edmonton Oilers in the 5th round of the 2006 NHL Entry Draft.
